title: Use Buildkite GitHub Actions migration without repository-native pipeline files
intent: Treat .github/workflows/*.yml as the sole repository workflow contract and rely on Buildkite's implemented GitHub Actions migration for execution; remove the obsolete .buildkite directory and preserve all workflow gates and semantics.
stop_conditions: Do not add a second native Buildkite workflow source or delete any .github/workflows/*.yml gate while verifying Buildkite's migration parity.
deferred_questions: After Buildkite migration parity is verified for pull requests, master, releases, docs, and tags, decide when to disable the GitHub Actions service.
